text: Final categorization: OK (Justification: The paper presents original research with a primary focus on national-scale land use and land cover (LULC) prediction in China from 2025 to 2050 under three distinct SSP-RCP scenarios—SSP245, SSP370, and SSP585. It explicitly implements spatial modeling at 500 m resolution across the entire country, uses a calibrated framework (LUH2-PLUS-InVEST) that includes quantitative accuracy metrics (e.g., overall accuracy >90%, Kappa = 0.92), and produces mapped LULC projections. All core inclusion criteria are met: national-scale implementation, primary focus on LULC simulation, ≥2 future scenarios with quantitative comparison, spatially explicit modeling with accuracy validation, and mapped outputs. The study is not a review, does not fall under any exclusion criteria, and LULC prediction is central—not incidental—to the research objective.)
